summary: Same-cycle source and integrity review remains blocked on the exact machine-cycle CI proof and same-cycle supervisor/Sheet completion, but one prior apparent inconsistency is now resolved: Beast reports five GEV causal edges because its audit intentionally counts only edges directly touching company:GEV, while causal-graph.json contains six total edges including one bottleneck-to-infrastructure edge. Machine identity/tradability/source reachability remain healthy; FINRA remains partition-freshness only, sensors remain non-gating, and an empty evidence queue does not imply discovery completion.

materialFindings.finding: The authoritative persisted cycle is 20260913T1300Z with 250/250 companies observed and identity/tradability validated, but only 1/250 scored and publishable, supervisor source coverage 0, discoveryScanCompleted false, qualifiedTick false and council review pending.

The exact machine-cycle SHA remains 31800bad5e349a9aae447477534533d4c7a98f30 for the reviewed deterministic boundary. Earth 2036 CI run 34760931146 is completed with conclusion action_required and no qualifying execution job, so it is neither a pass nor valid exact-SHA execution proof under the integrity contract.

Required machine-source health is internally coherent at its stated layer: all four machine sources are healthy with coverage 1.0, and Beast/sourceMesh passes for the single audited score record. That does not establish supervisor evidence acquisition or discovery completion, which are explicitly reset to zero/false for the new cycle.

FINRA OTC Daily List is healthy only for partition freshness. The committed artifact explicitly has observationMode=partition-freshness, eventDataAvailable=false and recordCount=null, so current row-level corporate actions remain unavailable from the automated probe and require lawful event-level retrieval/corroboration.

The prior five-versus-six GEV causal-edge discrepancy is resolved by code semantics, not by altering data. beast-integrity.mjs defines companyEdges as edges where edge.from===company:GEV or edge.to===company:GEV. causal-graph.json has six total edges, but exactly five directly touch company:GEV; edge:grid-capacity-bottlenecks-grid connects bottleneck:grid-equipment-capacity to infrastructure:power-grid and is intentionally excluded from the per-company count.

The evidence-review queue is empty with unresolved=0. This clears the queue-specific check only; it does not convert incomplete same-cycle discovery, supervisor coverage or company underwriting into complete acquisition.

Registered sensor sources remain explicitly non-gating. Their failures or blind spots must be visible as unknowns or research priorities, but they cannot change the active gating denominator unless a later explicit methodology decision changes their coverage role.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Document the Beast causal-edge counting semantics in an integrity-facing note or test: per-company causalEdges counts only direct company edges, while graph.edges is the total graph edge count. No causal data mutation is required for the resolved five-versus-six observation.

Keep the reviewed cycle unapproved until a real Earth 2036 CI verification job passes on an exact deterministic machine-cycle SHA. Do not substitute later branch-head CI for the missing 31800bad execution proof.
Keep FINRA semantics at partition-freshness/eventDataAvailable=false until row-level event retrieval or primary corroboration is actually acquired; do not convert endpoint freshness into event truth.

This is not a data contradiction if capability/reachability is kept separate from same-cycle intelligent acquisition; presenting all green states as equivalent completeness would be misleading.

unknowns.unknown: No reviewed same-cycle artifact proves repo-versus-Sheet parity for 20260913T1300Z; spreadsheetMirror=chatgpt-supervisor is not itself a content-parity proof.
FINRA row-level current OTC event data remains unavailable in the committed automated source artifact because eventDataAvailable=false.

peerRequests.request: Continue treating source availability as distinct from company-level evidence completeness; 4/4 machine health cannot support inferred factors for unscored companies.

The five-versus-six causal-edge audit issue is resolved: Beast counts five direct GEV edges and excludes the one bottleneck-to-grid edge. Use this code-defined scope in future parity checks rather than treating total graph edges as per-company edges.

accuracyDebates.topic: Can later successful branch-head CI cure the missing exact machine-SHA execution proof?
accuracyDebates.position: No. The contract explicitly requires a real verification job for the exact deterministic machine-cycle SHA; later append-only report identity is protected by blob SHA and finalizer validation instead.

accuracyDebates.topic: Was the GEV five-versus-six edge observation evidence of graph corruption?
accuracyDebates.position: No. Direct inspection of beast-integrity.mjs resolves it deterministically: the audit counts only edges incident to company:GEV, while the graph also stores one non-company bottleneck-to-infrastructure edge.
